findings.claim: 美國眾議院中國問題特別委員會主席 Moolenaar 於 2026-06-30 去函 Merck 與 AbbVie，要求說明在中國（含新疆與解放軍附屬醫院）進行臨床試驗的場址審查、資料保護與安全標準，7/17 前需回覆。
findings.source: Investing.com (Reuters) — US House committee opens investigation into Merck, AbbVie China drug trials
findings.excerpt: Rep. John Moolenaar, a Michigan Republican who chairs the House Select Committee on China, signed the Monday-dated letters calling on both companies to submit information by July 17 covering how they vet trial locations, protect data, and uphold safety standards — with particular scrutiny on sites in Xinjiang and at hospitals connected to China's military.

findings.claim: Merck 自 2005 年起在中國贊助或參與 224 項臨床研究，其中至少 31 項位於新疆、40 項在解放軍附屬醫院或醫療機構進行，成為本次國會調查的具體規模依據。
findings.source: GuruFocus — Merck (MRK) Faces National Security Scrutiny Over China Trials
findings.excerpt: Merck has sponsored or collaborated on 224 clinical studies in China since 2005, including at least 31 in Xinjiang and 40 at military-affiliated hospitals and medical centers.

geo_supply_chain.note: 查到 MRK 專屬的地緣風險事件（中國臨床試驗遭美國國會國安調查），但未查到 Merck & Co. 自身生產基地（原料藥/成品藥廠）具體地理集中度或單一供應商依賴的公開揭露；產業層級的 API 產地集中度（中國/印度佔比）雖有搜尋摘要提及，但因無法透過 WebFetch 確認原文與確切發布日期（Benzinga 403、另一頁未含該段落），依規則不列入 claim，避免使用未經驗證的日期。搜尋額度（4）與 WebFetch 額度（2）已用盡。
